segments.speaker: Grace
segments.text: Two years ago I lost my job and I did not know how we would pay rent. I prayed a lot but honestly mostly I was afraid.

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.text: Our neighbours brought food every week without being asked. I still get emotional thinking about it. That was how I learned I was not alone.

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.text: In March I started at the clinic. It is not the job I would have picked but I am grateful.
